title: Fix review findings on creating a folder on a Remote
body:
Fix the review findings on "create a folder on a Remote" (commits f885942 and 522d333: src/remote_browse.rs, src/remote_browse_ui.rs, src/remote_dir_prompt.rs, src/remotes_pane.rs, src/remote_probe.rs, src/settings_menu.rs tests). This is the only place foreman writes to a Remote's filesystem; a code review found two ways a folder gets created that the user did not ask for. No new features.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-20-remote-sessions-design.md (the directory picker part).
Blocked by: Create a folder on a Remote from the directory picker
Must fix:
1. Typing in the list can create a junk folder. route_typing in remote_browse_ui.rs opens the name field on a bare N, and what is typed next lands in the name: with the list focused, typing "node" to filter opens the field with "ode" in it and Enter creates a folder named "ode" on the Remote. The human decided: the keyboard trigger is Ctrl+N. A bare letter (n included) always goes to the filter/text field as before this feature. The "+ new folder" row stays clickable and reachable with the arrows plus Enter. Update every hint. Also: Enter must not create until the name field has been shown for at least one frame and holds a name the user typed in it.
2. A typed path that does not exist becomes a folder without the user typing a name. start_naming pre-fills the name with the current filter text, so "~/src/proj", Down, new folder, Enter creates "proj". The spec says choose the action, type a name, Enter. Start the name field EMPTY, always.
Should fix:
3. A timeout reads as a plain failure. run_raw kills ssh at the deadline, possibly after mkdir ran; the message says only to press Enter to try again, the parent is not refreshed (refresh runs on Ok only, in take_made), and the retry says "already taken" while the folder is not in the list. On any outcome that is not a definite script-level failure, refresh the parent listing and say the folder may have been made. Esc closing the name field, or the widget being dropped, while a create is running must not lose the outcome silently: refresh the parent when it ends.
4. Overlapping creates share one slot (made is a single Option). Esc, reopen and Enter while the first create is still running starts a second. Allow one create at a time per picker: while one runs, the action shows it is busy and cannot start another.
5. Whitespace-only and leading/trailing-space names are accepted on Posix (an invisible folder). Reject a name that is empty after trimming, and trim nothing silently: say why.
6. Windows shells (still labelled untested): reject reserved device names (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1-9, LPT1-9, with or without an extension) and names ending in a space or dot; build the create with -LiteralPath semantics for the full path so [ and ] are not wildcards; it must fail, not create parents, if the parent vanished between the check and the create.
7. Tests still reach the network. 522d333 pinned reachability for one layout test with put_reach, but other settings_menu tests that select Pane::Remotes and render rows still call remote_probe::reach, which spawns a real `ssh -G` and a TCP connect. Under cfg(test) the probe, the Test action, the folder listing and the folder create must NEVER spawn a process or open a socket unless a test opts in explicitly; make that structural (one cfg(test) seam in remote_probe / remote_browse), not per-test pinning, and remove put_reach calls that it makes redundant. Add a test that fails if a probe is started under test without the opt-in.
8. The create worker thread, the made slot and the repaint path are never run in tests (the cfg(test) branch of create returns early). Give create an injectable runner so a test drives the real thread path with a fake command result, including the timeout and the dropped-widget cases above.
You may create and remove throwaway folders ONLY under /tmp/foreman-mkdir-test on andy@192.168.8.168 (key login, never ask for a password) and must remove that directory afterwards.
Done when:
- egui::Context::run tests: with the list focused, typing "node" filters and creates nothing; Ctrl+N opens an EMPTY name field; Enter in the same frame the field opens does nothing; Enter with an untouched empty field does nothing; a second create cannot start while one runs
- unit tests for 3, 5, 6 and 8, and the structural no-network-under-test guard from 7
- the full test suite passes twice in a row
Gate: cargo test --target-dir target/agent
